nodes.label: Rice Plant Photo (Padi)
nodes.description: Photograph of a rice plant (Oryza sativa). Long narrow linear leaf blades with parallel venation confirm Poaceae/grass family identification consistent with rice (padi). Detailed disease assessment could not be fully confirmed from image but plant displays some yellowing/browning indicators. Rice blast, bacterial leaf blight, and brown spot are common diseases assessed for this crop.

edges.note: Padi plant photo is displayed as a selection card on the home/plant selection screen
Padi photo relates to the disease detection app workflow documented in Panduan
